items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: And then Madame Eugene Schaffner's niece. It was Voltaire, I think was her name. ... I took from ... Voltaire

ctx.x: You must have had a lot of teachers. We haven't covered them all.

Well, let's see. The teachers, we started off with my mother, primarily. I can't forget her. And then my uncle, Duy Schmid, he helped me out with a lot of the faking part of it. Buzzy Williams. I had another fellow that played fine piano with, speaking of piano, his name was Emile Schindler. He never did play professionally, but he used to play very, very fine ragtime piano and good legitimate piano. He helped me out a little bit. Emile Schindler, and then I took from Vic Lebowski, Howard Tiff, Madame Eugene…
